name: serde_yaml
note: Archived upstream; libyaml port via unsafe-libyaml.
reason: Selected. Pinned 0.9.34+deprecated parses both schema-neutral YAML controls into the exact typed trees of controls/yaml/check_controls.py; Docker coverage 649 own lines and 2002 unsafe-libyaml lines; AFL++ scoped to serde_yaml, unsafe_libyaml: 5 identical repeats per control, 1525 vs 1530 edges, 91/96 unique.

name: unsafe-libyaml
reason: Not run as a separate path. unsafe-libyaml 0.2.11 is the c2rust libyaml translation that the selected serde_yaml path drives (its scanner and parser lines are recorded as underlying coverage there). Its only API is the unsafe C-style yaml_parser_* event interface over raw pointers, with docs.rs listing the translated functions but no documented safe local text entry point; its downloads are almost entirely as serde_yaml's dependency.
